Name: Lucky's Portraits for Sunberry Village
Author: Lucky370
Description:
Portraits for the characters from Sunberry Village 

A Content Patcher and Portraiture version

The code for the Content patcher version was provided by the lovely GenbuWore
Thank u so much


For portraiture
Simply download the file and put the "Lucky's Sunberry Village" folder in youre portraiture mod folder
You can remove the images from the folder and put them with your other portraiture images if you don't want a separate folder


For CP
SImply download, and extract into your mod folder




I will work on all add on npc's in the future

If any portrait looks off or bugs you in any way, let me know i'm willing to adjust or patch things. I might even redo some in the future when my art style has become more polished and consistent.


If anyone knows how to code a content patcher mod for this then please let me know, i need help :)
